Calculator.title: Palworld Breeding Calculator
Calculator.description: Use this free Palworld breeding calculator to find child results from two parents, or reverse look up every known breeding combination for a target Pal. Results update instantly as you select Pals.
Calculator.summary: {breedable} breedable Pals · {unique} unique recipes · data for {version}
Calculator.noResult: No breeding result for this pair.
Calculator.reverseTitle: Find how to breed a target Pal
Calculator.reverseHint: Select a target Pal to see breeding combinations.
Calculator.noCombinations: No known combinations for this Pal in the current dataset.
Calculator.howToTitle: How to use this Palworld breeding calculator
Calculator.howToForwardBody: Select Parent 1 and Parent 2. The Palworld breeding calculator immediately shows the child Pal from the breeding formula, including unique recipe overrides when they apply. Open the child Pal page, jump to its breeding guide, or switch modes to find more parent pairs.
Calculator.howToReverseBody: Choose the Pal you want to breed. This reverse lookup lists known parent combinations so you can plan routes for Anubis, Jetragon, Frostallion, and other high-demand Pals without guessing.
Calculator.worksP1: In Palworld, breeding is deterministic for species: the same two parents always produce the same child Pal. Gender matters at the Breeding Farm (you still need one male and one female plus Cake), but it does not change which species you get — and parent order does not matter either.
Calculator.worksP2: Most outcomes use each Pal's hidden CombiRank. The game averages the two parents with floor((rankA + rankB + 1) / 2), then picks the breedable Pal whose CombiRank is closest to that target. When two Pals sit at the same distance, a duplicate-priority rule breaks the tie. That is why many different pairs still hatch common low-rank Pals.
Calculator.worksP3: A smaller set of special recipes overrides the formula. Fixed parent pairs always produce a specific subspecies or rare child — for example Vanwyrm Cryst, Relaxaurus Lux, Mossanda Lux, or other unique lines. If a pair matches one of those recipes, the unique child wins over the CombiRank result.
Calculator.worksP4: This Palworld breeding calculator uses the same two layers: unique recipes first, then the CombiRank formula. Pick two parents to see the child instantly, or reverse look up a target Pal to list parent pairs. Results are generated from our imported game tables so what you see here matches what you should get at a Breeding Farm for the current dataset version.
Calculator.popularDescription: Open a dedicated breeding guide, or load the target in the calculator for an instant reverse lookup.
Calculator.faq1Q: What is a Palworld breeding calculator?
Calculator.faq1A: A Palworld breeding calculator is a tool that predicts breeding outcomes. On Palworld Hub you can either pick two parents to see the child, or pick a target Pal to find parent combinations that produce it.
Calculator.faq2Q: How do I find the child of two parent Pals?
Calculator.faq2A: Stay on Parents → Child, select both parents, and the child result appears instantly. No Calculate button is required.
Calculator.faq3Q: How do I find all ways to breed a target Pal?
Calculator.faq3A: Switch to Target → Parents, choose your target Pal, and review the combination grid. You can also open that Pal's SEO breeding page for a shareable guide.
Calculator.faq4Q: Is this Palworld breeding calculator up to date?
Calculator.faq4A: Yes. Results are generated from the current Palworld Hub dataset for {version}, including unique breeding recipes and formula-based combinations for breedable Pals.
Calculator.exploreBody: Browse the full Pal database for stats and work suitability, or open popular breeding guides when you already know which Pal you want.
Calculator.datasetDescription: Palworld breeding combination dataset powering the Palworld breeding calculator, including unique recipes and formula-based parent-to-child results.

BreedingHub.title: Palworld Breeding Combos
BreedingHub.description: Find Palworld breeding combos fast: see real parent + parent = child examples below, browse unique recipes, then open a Pal guide for every pair that produces it — or what it breeds as a parent.
BreedingHub.featuredDescription: Sample unique recipes from the current dataset. Each card is a real breeding combo — click the child to open its full guide.
BreedingHub.popularDescription: High-demand Pals with example parent pairs. Open a guide for the full searchable combo list.
BreedingHub.allDescription: Every breedable Pal has a dedicated breeding combos page: parents that produce it, and outcomes when it is used as a parent.
BreedingHub.howBody: A breeding combo is a parent pair that produces a specific child Pal. Most outcomes use each parent’s CombiRank and the game formula. A smaller set of unique recipes always produce a fixed child. On Palworld Hub you can browse example combos here, open a Pal guide for the full list, or use the calculator for a live lookup.
BreedingHub.howTipBody: Gender does not change the child species — only which two parents you pick. Use a Pal’s Breed tab to farm that Pal, or its As parent tab to see what it produces with partners.
BreedingHub.faq1A: Breeding combos are parent pairs that hatch a given child Pal. This page shows unique recipe examples and links to full combo guides for every breedable Pal.
BreedingHub.faq2Q: Where can I see all combos for one Pal?
BreedingHub.faq2A: Open that Pal’s breeding guide from the list below. You’ll get every parent pair that produces it, plus outcomes when that Pal is used as a parent.
BreedingHub.faq3Q: How is this different from the breeding calculator?
BreedingHub.faq3A: This breeding database is for browsing and sharing combo guides. The calculator is for instant live lookups when you already know which parents or target Pal you want to test.
BreedingHub.empty: No breeding guides matched your search.

About.title: About {siteName}
About.intro: {siteName} is a free fan-made tools site for Palworld players. We help you look up Pal stats, plan breeding routes, and open shareable guides for popular Pals.
About.s1Body: Use the Pal database to browse elements, combat stats, work suitability, partner skills, and drops. Use the breeding calculator to find a child from two parents, or reverse look up parent combinations for a target Pal. Dedicated breeding pages make it easy to share a specific guide.
About.s2Body: Palworld Hub is built around game-derived data tables for the current Palworld 1.0 release. We refresh breeding recipes, CombiRank results, and Pal details as the dataset is updated. Results are for planning and reference — always confirm important outcomes in your own game.
About.s3Body: {siteName} is an unofficial fan project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Pocketpair or any other Palworld rights holder. Palworld and related names, characters, and assets belong to their respective owners.
About.s4Body: Need a correction, have feedback, or want to reach us about privacy?

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how {siteName} (“we”, “us”) handles information when you visit {siteUrl}.

Privacy.s3Body: We may use essential cookies or similar technologies required for the site to function. If we use privacy-friendly analytics or advertising-related technologies in the future, we will update this policy and, where required, provide notice or consent options.
Privacy.s4Body: Technical and contact information is used only to run and improve {siteName}, respond to messages you send us, protect against abuse, and meet legal obligations. We do not sell your personal information.
Privacy.s5Body: We may share limited technical data with infrastructure providers that host or deliver the site (for example CDN or hosting vendors) solely to operate the service. We may also disclose information if required by law or to protect the rights, safety, and integrity of the site and its users.
Privacy.s6Body: Server logs and similar technical records are retained only as long as reasonably needed for operations, security, and debugging. Emails you send us are kept as long as needed to handle your request.
Privacy.s7Body: The site is intended for a general audience of game players. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided personal information to us, contact us and we will take appropriate steps.
Privacy.s8Body: Depending on where you live, you may have rights to request access to, correction of, or deletion of personal information we hold about you. To make a request, email us at {email}.
Privacy.s9Body: If you access {siteName} from outside the region where our hosting infrastructure operates, your information may be processed in other countries that have different data-protection rules.
Privacy.s10Body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The “Last updated” date at the top of this page will change when we do. Continued use of the site after an update means you acknowledge the revised policy.
Privacy.s11Body: For privacy questions or requests, contact us at {email}.
